name: Ultra Stalker V7.9
notes: Ultra Stalker V7.9 final. Keeps the fast V7.8 runtime unchanged while adding OpenViX-friendly dependency handling, native embedded subtitles with Ultra UI, dedicated AUDIO track selection while YELLOW stays subtitles-only, Parental Lock fixes, Arabic/English/Turkish/French SubDL, and unified Portal Settings UI with real URL/expiry plus Backup & Restore.
